in_english.name: Ishmael
in_english.long_meaning: Ishmael is a name meaning 'God hears' or 'God listens'. In the Bible, Ishmael is the name of the firstborn son of Abraham and Hagar, born after Isaac. The name Ishmael signifies God's hearing and listening, and it is an example of a name that reflects God's listening and hearing. Ishmael is a biblical name that has been used in Christian tradition to signify God's hearing and listening. In modern times, Ishmael is a popular name in Christian cultures, symbolizing God's listening and hearing.

biblical_reference.note: The name Ishmael is mentioned in the Bible as the name of the firstborn son of Abraham and Hagar.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ishmael has historical and cultural significance in the Jewish and Muslim traditions. In both faiths, Ishmael is recognized as the ancestor of the Arabs. He is revered in Islamic tradition, particularly in connection with the Hajj pilgrimage, and is mentioned in various hadiths and Quranic verses.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ishmael is a poignant reminder of God's faithfulness, even in the midst of difficult circumstances. As Abraham and Hagar were cast out into the wilderness, God promised them that their male child would become the father of a great nation. The name Ishmael, 'God hears', serves as a powerful reminder that regardless of one's circumstances or Personal struggles, God is always listening, always present, and always offers hope and promise for a better future.
